title: The night crossing
summary: The Hydaspes, 326 BCE: Alexander steals a crossing against Porus in a night of storm, and lands on an island. Drag the column and the night moves under your finger.

doorway.label: An elephant at the water on the Jhelum: the night crossing of the Hydaspes, 326 BCE

whatsNew.what: Touch the camp on the near bank, then drag the column along its way: the night moves under your finger, and the river opens in front of them.
whatsNew.ask: At the second channel, did you lean in, or did you need to be told what had happened?
